newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill cuts Scholastic.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill cuts Scholastic.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it downgraded Scholastic Corp to near-term reduce from accumulate, long-term neutral from buy.
-- Merrill analyst William Bird said he cut his fiscal year 1997 earnings estimate on Scholastic to $2.00 from $3.25 and dropped fiscal 1998 to $2.50 from $3.85.
-- Bird had no further immediate comment.

-- Scholastic said late Thursday it expects a fiscal third quarter loss of between $0.70 and $0.80 per share, which includes $0.50 per share to cover a $13 million pre-tax special charge consisting of a reserve for anticipated additional retail book returns.
